title: ROOTBOUND
tagline: A plant that thrives shades the ones beside it. The bed you laid out perfectly stops working because it worked.

metadata.accessibilityNote: DELIBERATELY EMPTY, and the value is what the publishing path reads (wing §3h item 3). The game is text heavy and mouse driven, colour carries meaning in the four data overlays, and nothing here has been MEASURED against itch's accessibility rows. An unmeasured row is a lie on a live page.
metadata.madeWith: Hand written HTML5 canvas and vanilla JavaScript
metadata.mobileNote: MEASURED 2026-09-07 and the honest answer is NO. play_probe renders the shipped build at a 390x844 phone viewport: it FITS with no scrollbar (canvas 390x600) but the UI type is far too small to read, so the game is not usable on a phone. Touch input is genuinely wired and works, but claiming Touchscreen beside mobileFriendly false would be contradictory, so inputs are Mouse and Keyboard. Screenshot: Internal_Ops/play_proof/viewport_phone.png. A listing row that is a lie is worse than an absent one.

devlogTitle: ROOTBOUND is live, and four of its twelve plants had nowhere to live
